internal_sales.list.quote.title: Internal sales quotes
internal_sales.list.quote.description: HQ quotes to a branch — not the proforma invoice (PI) that backs a collection; lines reference the app-owned product master and stay editable in this module. Two ways to order: “New order from this quote” keeps the quote and lets you edit the result; “Convert to order” converts in place, so the quote no longer exists.
internal_sales.list.order.title: Internal sales orders (PO)
internal_sales.list.order.description: HQ sales orders to a branch; fulfilment (shipments, invoices, payments) still runs on the installed sales chain.
internal_sales.form.linePrecision: Line {line}: quantity and unit price accept at most 4 decimal places.
internal_sales.list.actions.convertConfi: Convert this quote into an order?
The quote becomes an order in place: it keeps its lines and its buyer snapshot and gets a new order number, but the quote itself no longer exists — this cannot be undone.
internal_sales.form.quoteLoad.dialogBody: Choose a quote to load its header and lines into this order in one go. Everything stays editable, and the saved order records its source quote.
